The '''2010 FA Community Shield''' (also known as '''The FA Community Shield sponsored by [[McDonald's]]''' for sponsorship reasons) was the 88th [[FA Community Shield]], an annual [[association football|football]] match contested by the winners of the previous season's [[Premier League]] and [[FA Cup]] competitions. A rematch of the [[2009 FA Community Shield|previous year's FA Community Shield]], the match was played at [[Wembley Stadium]], [[London]], on 8 August 2010,<ref name="date"/> and contested by [[2009–10 Premier League|league]] and [[2009–10 FA Cup|cup]] [[Double (association football)|double]] winners [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]] and league runners-up [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]]. Manchester United won the match 3–1 with goals from [[Antonio Valencia]], [[Javier Hernández]] and [[Dimitar Berbatov]]; Chelsea's consolation goal came from [[Salomon Kalou]].<ref>{{cite news |first=Paul |last=Fletcher |title=Chelsea 1–3 Man Utd |url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/8893192.stm |publisher=BBC Sport |date=8 August 2010 |access-date=9 August 2010 | archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20100808191326/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/8893192.stm| archive-date= 8 August 2010 | url-status= live}}</ref> It was Manchester United's 14th outright victory in the Community Shield.<ref>{{cite news |title=United claim Community Shield success |url=http://soccernet.espn.go.com/report?id=296926&cc=5739&league=ENG.CHARITY |work=ESPNsoccernet |date=8 August 2010 |access-date=9 August 2010 |archive-date=23 October 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121023084302/http://soccernet.espn.go.com/report?id=296926&cc=5739&league=ENG.CHARITY |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Chelsea went into the match as trophy-holders, having won the [[2009 FA Community Shield|2009 edition]]. The Shield is usually contested by the winners of the Premier League and the FA Cup, but since Chelsea won the double, Manchester United qualified by default as Premier League runners-up. It was the third time in four years that the Community Shield had been contested between the two teams, having also met in [[2007 FA Community Shield|2007]].
